correctness.rationale: Uniform empirical measure converges, h_n(u)=E_mu_n |u-X| converges uniformly to h(u)>=1/4, so conditional ordered sampled pair converges to du |u-v|dv/h(u). The empirical optimal two-median cost converges to 1/8. Sorted pair joint density q(u,v)=(v-u)[h(u)^(-1)+h(v)^(-1)] and R=4(a^2+c^2)+2b^2=1+4(s-1/2)^2+2d^2 give exact support and extrema. Independently computed polynomial conditional moment integrals N1=(34u^4-68u^3+54u^2-20u+5)/48, N2=11(2u²-2u+1)(11u⁴-22u³+15u²-4u+1)/480; obtain E R=7pi/12-4/9 and E R²=154/75. The minimum ellipse and two maximum corners with density ~4b lead to lower epsilon coefficient 4pi/(5sqrt2) and upper epsilon³/384. This is analytic, not only quadrature.
